021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy.benefit.BenefitProvider;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text.ProxiedLocale;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
024import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.IShopType;
025import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.state.ShopState;
026import com.ghostchu.quickshop.common.util.JsonUtil;
027import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
028import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
029import org.bukkit.block.Block;
030import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
031import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
032import org.jetbrains.annotations.ApiStatus;
033import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
034import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
035
036import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
037import java.util.Locale;
038import java.util.Map;
039import java.util.Objects;
040import java.util.UUID;
041
042/**
043 * ShopMeta
044 *
045 * @author creatorfromhell
046 * @since 6.3.0.0
047 */
048public interface ShopMeta<U> extends ShopPrice<U> {
049
050  /**
051   * WARNING: This UUID will changed after plugin reload, shop reload or server restart DO NOT USE
052   * IT TO STORE DATA!
053   *
054   * @return Random UUID
055   */
056  @NotNull
057  UUID getRuntimeRandomUniqueId();
058
059  /**
060   * Gets the Shop ID to identify the shop.
061   *
062   * @return Shop ID -1 if shop in creating state.
063   */
064  long getShopId();
065
066  /**
067   * Internal Only: Give shop that under id_waiting state an ShopId.
068   *
069   * @param newId The new shop id, once set will cannot change anymore.
070   */
071  @ApiStatus.Internal
072  void setShopId(long newId);
073
074  /**
075   * Gets this shop name that set by player
076   *
077   * @return Shop name, or null if not set
078   */
079  @Nullable
080  String getShopName();
081
082  /**
083   * Sets shop name
084   *
085   * @param shopName shop name, null to remove currently name
086   */
087  void setShopName(@Nullable String shopName);
088
089  /**
090   * Get shop item's ItemStack
091   *
092   * @return The shop's ItemStack
093   */
094  @NotNull
095  ItemStack getItem();
096
097  /**
098   * Set shop item's ItemStack
099   *
100   * @param item ItemStack to set
101   */
102  void setItem(@NotNull ItemStack item);
103
104  /**
105   * Get shop block
106   *
107   * @return The shop's block
108   */
109  @NotNull
110  Block getShopBlock();
111
112  /**
113   * Gets the currency that shop use
114   *
115   * @return The currency name
116   */
117  @Nullable
118  String getCurrency();
119
120  /**
121   * Sets the currency that shop use
122   *
123   * @param currency The currency name; null to use default currency
124   */
125  void setCurrency(@Nullable String currency);
126
127  /**
128   * Get shop's price
129   *
130   * @return Price
131   * @deprecated Use {@link ShopPrice#price()} instead
132   */
133  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
134  double getPrice();
135
136  /**
137   * Set shop's new price
138   *
139   * @param paramDouble New price
140   * @deprecated Use {@link ShopPrice#price(Object)} instead.
141   */
142  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
143  void setPrice(double paramDouble);
144
145  /**
146   * Retrieves the current state of the shop.
147   *
148   * @return the current state of the shop as a ShopState object
149   */
150  ShopState shopState();
151
152  /**
153   * Updates the current state of the shop based on the provided {@code ShopState}.
154   *
155   * @param state the new state to set for the shop; must not be null
156   */
157  void shopState(@NotNull ShopState state);
158
159  /**
160   * Updates or processes the state of a shop based on the provided identifier.
161   *
162   * @param shopStateIdentifier a non-null string representing the unique identifier
163   *                             for the shop state to be updated or processed.
164   */
165  void shopState(@NotNull String shopStateIdentifier);
166
167  /**
168   * Retrieves the type of shop associated with this entity.
169   *
170   * @return an instance of IShopType representing the shop type
171   */
172  IShopType shopType();
173
174  /**
175   * Sets the type of shop using the provided shop type parameter.
176   *
177   * @param newShopType the shop type to set, must not be null
178   */
179  void shopType(@NotNull IShopType newShopType);
180
181  /**
182   * Specifies the type of shop based on the given identifier.
183   *
184   * @param shopTypeIdentifier the identifier representing the type of shop. Must not be null.
185   */
186  void shopType(@NotNull String shopTypeIdentifier);
187
188  /**
189   * Get shop's owner name, it will return owner name or Admin Shop(i18n) when it is unlimited
190   *
191   * @param forceUsername Force returns username of shop
192   * @param locale        The locale to parse the message
193   *
194   * @return owner name
195   */
196  @NotNull
197  Component ownerName(boolean forceUsername, @NotNull ProxiedLocale locale);
198
199  /**
200   * Get shop's owner name, it will return owner name or Admin Shop(i18n) when it is unlimited
201   *
202   * @param locale The locale to parse the message
203   *
204   * @return owner name
205   */
206  @NotNull
207  Component ownerName(@NotNull ProxiedLocale locale);
208
209  /**
210   * Get shop's owner name, it will return owner name or Admin Shop(i18n) when it is unlimited
211   *
212   * @return owner name
213   */
214  @NotNull
215  Component ownerName();
216
217
218  /**
219   * Get shop's owner QUser
220   *
221   * @return Shop's owner QUser object, can use Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer to convert to the
222   * OfflinePlayer.
223   */
224  @NotNull
225  QUser getOwner();
226
227  /**
228   * Set new owner to the shop's owner
229   *
230   * @param qUser New owner user
231   */
232  void setOwner(@NotNull QUser qUser);
233
234  /**
235   * Getting the shop tax account for using, it can be specific uuid or general tax account
236   *
237   * @return Shop Tax Account or fallback to general tax account
238   */
239  @Nullable
240  QUser getTaxAccount();
241
242  /**
243   * Sets shop taxAccount
244   *
245   * @param taxAccount tax account, null to use general tax account
246   */
247  void setTaxAccount(@Nullable QUser taxAccount);
248
249  /**
250   * Getting the shop tax account, it can be specific uuid or general tax account
251   *
252   * @return Shop Tax Account, null if use general tax account
253   */
254
255  @Nullable
256  QUser getTaxAccountActual();
257
258  /**
259   * Gets shop status is stacking shop
260   *
261   * @return The shop stacking status
262   */
263  boolean isStackingShop();
264
265  /**
266   * Get shop is or not in Unlimited Mode (Admin Shop)
267   *
268   * @return yes or not
269   */
270  boolean isUnlimited();
271
272  /**
273   * Set shop is or not Unlimited Mode (Admin Shop)
274   *
275   * @param paramBoolean status
276   */
277  void setUnlimited(boolean paramBoolean);
278
279  /**
280   * Gets the benefit in this shop
281   */
282  @NotNull
283  BenefitProvider getShopBenefit();
284
285  /**
286   * Sets the benefit in this shop
287   */
288  void setShopBenefit(@NotNull BenefitProvider benefit);
289}
